sources.finding: Pi is a minimal extensible agent harness; skips sub-agents and plan mode; interactive, print/JSON, RPC and SDK modes; installs via curl/PowerShell/npm/Nix; no built-in permission system; requires Node.js 22.19+.

sources.title: Use Pi in the terminal
sources.locator: Enter a prompt; Change direction; Continue or start over; Run a terminal command
sources.finding: Terminal transcript and editor; Enter steers a running task, Alt+Enter queues a follow-up, Escape stops; sessions auto-saved, /resume, /tree, /fork, /compact, /export; footer shows context usage and accumulated cost.

sources.title: Pi quickstart
sources.finding: Install, run pi in a folder, /login to use a subscription, API key or a local model.

sources.title: Providers
sources.finding: /login supports OAuth or API keys; many providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Mistral, Groq, xAI, OpenRouter, Bedrock, Vertex and more); credentials stored in auth.json.

sources.title: pi-ai README
sources.finding: Lists API-key providers and OAuth providers including OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT Plus/Pro, legacy), GitHub Copilot and Kimi For Coding subscription endpoint.

sources.title: MCP servers
sources.finding: Pi is an MCP client for stdio and streamable HTTP servers with pi mcp add/list, /mcp, user and project config and bearer/OAuth auth; project config needs project trust.

sources.title: Run Pi safely
sources.locator: Choose how to run Pi; Understand project trust
sources.finding: Pi does not ask approval before every tool call and has no security boundary; project trust gates loading of .pi resources; sandboxing is by running Pi in container, VM or sandbox.

sources.title: Run Pi in an isolated environment
sources.finding: Plain Docker, Docker Sandboxes, OpenShell and the Gondolin micro-VM extension are documented isolation methods; credentials handling differs.

sources.title: RPC mode
sources.locator: Start RPC mode; Protocol records; Reference
sources.finding: pi --mode rpc runs Pi as a subprocess with JSONL commands, responses and events for IDEs and custom UIs; extension UI forwarding.

sources.title: SDK
sources.locator: Session lifecycle; Prompting; Subscribing to events
sources.finding: TypeScript SDK embeds Pi sessions in Node.js or Bun with prompting, events and session configuration.

sources.title: Sessions and context
sources.locator: Continue or switch sessions; Choose how to branch; Manage conversation context; Export or share a session
sources.finding: Saved sessions with /resume, /tree, /fork, /clone, compaction, /export HTML/JSONL and /share upload.

sources.title: Settings
sources.finding: Retry settings (3 retries, exponential backoff); enableInstallTelemetry default true; enableAnalytics default false.

sources.title: Environment variables
sources.finding: PI_TELEMETRY overrides install/update telemetry and attribution headers; PI_OFFLINE disables automatic network activity.

sources.title: Packages
sources.locator: Install and manage packages; Create a package
sources.finding: Pi packages bundle extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes installed from npm, git or paths with project or user scope.

sources.title: Extensions
sources.locator: Examples table (subagent/, plan-mode/, ssh.ts, git-checkpoint, permission-gate, notify, todo)
sources.finding: Extensions register tools, commands, UI and hooks; the examples directory ships optional example extensions for sub-agents, plan mode, SSH, permission gates, git checkpoints and todos that are not enabled by default.

sources.title: Skills
sources.finding: Pi loads agent skills, AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md context files and prompt templates.

sources.title: Choose a model
sources.finding: Models are selected with /model; custom and local providers (llama.cpp docs) can be configured through models.json.

sources.title: Run Pi on Windows
sources.finding: Native Windows (Git Bash or PowerShell tool) or WSL are supported; README also documents Termux and Nix for Linux/macOS.

sources.title: Compaction
sources.finding: Conversation history is compacted manually or automatically near the context limit.

sources.title: Command line
sources.finding: Interactive, print (-p), JSON and RPC modes; --continue, --session-dir, --no-session, --offline.

sources.title: pi-durable README
sources.locator: Intro; Persist and Resume; Abort and Subagents
sources.finding: Experimental durable agent harness runtime committing conversations and tool calls to storage so a dead process resumes; API changes without notice.

sources.title: pi-chat repository
sources.finding: Separate Apache-2.0 repository for Slack/chat automation and workflows with Pi.

sources.title: Gondolin repository
sources.finding: Experimental Linux micro-VM sandbox with a TypeScript control plane (Apache-2.0), used by the Gondolin extension to isolate built-in tools.

sources.title: coding-agent package.json
sources.finding: Package @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent version 1.5.0, license MIT, bin pi.

sources.title: Auth storage
sources.finding: Credential storage for API keys and OAuth tokens per provider with refresh flows (anthropic, openai-codex, github-copilot providers).

sources.title: MCP server loader
sources.finding: Implements MCP client loading of user and project servers.

sources.title: Session manager
sources.finding: Session persistence as JSONL entries with parent IDs enabling tree branching, compaction entries and export.

sources.title: Install telemetry
sources.finding: Install/update telemetry reporting gated by enableInstallTelemetry and PI_TELEMETRY.

sources.title: Bounded source search of the pinned release
sources.locator: Paths packages/coding-agent/src, packages/agent/src, packages/coding-agent/docs; terms: worktree, issue tracker, kanban, backlog, pull request, createPullRequest, cron, scheduler, multiplayer, collaborat, co-prompt, rbac, sso, saml, organization role, subagent, plan mode, webhook
sources.finding: No built-in worktree management, issue tracker, kanban, pull request integration, scheduler, multi-user collaboration, roles or SSO exists in core; matches are the footer showing a git worktree name, cache warming, documentation of examples (subagent, plan-mode) and unrelated identifiers.

sources.title: SSH example extension
sources.finding: Optional example extension routing tools to a remote host over SSH; not enabled by default.
